earnings.title: For Immediate Release
highlights: Diluted Earnings Per Share (“EPS”) increased 36.7% to $0.82

Net sales for the first quarter of fiscal 2027 grew 5.5% compared to the prior year period to $18.0 billion primarily driven by an increase in organic cases sold, incremental sales from recent acquisitions, and an increase in selling price per case as a result of inflation.

quotes.text: We started fiscal 2027 with solid momentum, delivering strong first-quarter sales and profit growth.
quotes.by: Scott McPherson, PFG’s President and Chief Executive Officer

outlook: For the second quarter of fiscal 2027, PFG expects net sales to be in a range of approximately $17.0 billion to $17.2 billion and Adjusted EBITDA to be in a range of approximately $490 million to $510 million.

For the full fiscal year 2027, PFG continues to expect net sales to be in a range of approximately $72.5 billion to $73.0 billion and Adjusted EBITDA to be in a range of approximately $2.125 billion to $2.225 billion.

items.heading: Risk Factors - Risks Relating to Product Safety, Regulatory and Legal Matters- Our business is subject to significant governmental regulation, and costs or claims for non-compliance related to these requirements could adversely affect our business.

Periods of difficult economic conditions, other macroeconomic or geopolitical events and heightened uncertainty in the financial markets may affect consumer spending and confidence, which can adversely affect our business.
